food_identity: East-coast surf town combining exceptionally fresh seafood, Sri Lankan rice-and-curry, Tamil/South-Indian food, roti/kottu, vegetarian surf cafés, beach restaurants and hands-on cooking classes.
best_use_cases: fresh-catch dinners,budget local curry,post-surf meals,vegetarian food,beach dining,cooking classes,late-night food
notable_food_areas: Main Street/Panama Road,beachfront,Sinhapura Road,Pottuvil/Arugam Bay fringe
social_insights: Current reviews and community discussions suggest that seafood freshness and surf-town atmosphere are major strengths, while authenticity/spice level can vary between tourist-facing venues. The recommender should separate popularity, freshness, local authenticity, dietary fit and nightlife atmosphere.
